result.topic_en: Euler derives the partial differential equation for the transverse vibrations of an elastic rod under an axial force E, specializes it to the case E = 0, admits that its general integral cannot be found, and begins discussing the cases where the rod is stretched or compressed.
result.transcription:
) 109 (
haec aequatio denuo differentiata ac per $ds$ diuisa praebebit istam:
$\frac{E\,ddy}{ds^2} + \frac{cc}{2g}\left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right) = -\frac{bc^4\,d^4y}{ds^4}$,
quae, quo discrimen inter binas variabiles $s$ et $t$ clarius ob oculos ponatur, more solito ita repraesentetur:
$E\left(\frac{ddy}{ds^2}\right) + \frac{cc}{2g}\left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right) = -bc^4\left(\frac{d^4y}{ds^4}\right)$.
Corollarium I.
§. 5. Quod si ergo virga a nullis plane viribus externis extendatur, ita vt sit $E=0$, aequatio motum virgae determinans erit
$\frac{cc}{2g}\left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right) = -bc^4\left(\frac{d^4y}{ds^4}\right)$, siue
$\frac{1}{2g}\left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right) = -bcc\left(\frac{d^4y}{ds^4}\right)$;
ita vt totum negotium huc sit reductum, quemadmodum ista aequatio differentialis quarti gradus integrari queat; vbi quidem in limine confiteri cogimur, eius integrale nullo adhuc modo inueniri potuisse, ita vt contenti esse debeamus in solutiones particulares inquirere.
Corollarium II.
§. 6. Sin autem accedat vis litera E indicata, eius duo casus perpendendi occurrunt: prouti virga ab ea vel extenditur vel comprimitur. Talis enim virga, quatenus est rigida, etiam vires sustinere potest, quae ipsam comprimere conantur, cuiusmodi vires eo maiores esse possunt, quo maior fuerit elasticitas; si enim esset perfecte flexilis, nulla plane vis comprimens admitti posset, vnde pro quouis elasticitatis gradu indagandum erit, quantam vim comprimentem sustinere valeat, antequam incurue-
O 3

items.quote: ita vt totum negotium huc sit reductum, quemadmodum ista aequatio differentialis quarti gradus integrari queat
items.english: so that the whole matter is reduced to how this differential equation of the fourth order can be integrated

items.quote: vbi quidem in limine confiteri cogimur, eius integrale nullo adhuc modo inueniri potuisse, ita vt contenti esse debeamus in solutiones particulares inquirere.
items.english: where indeed at the outset we are forced to confess that its integral could not yet be found in any way, so that we must be content to search for particular solutions.

items.quote: vnde pro quouis elasticitatis gradu indagandum erit, quantam vim comprimentem sustinere valeat, antequam incurue-
items.english: hence for any degree of elasticity it will have to be investigated how great a compressing force the rod can sustain before it is bent

items.quote: si enim esset perfecte flexilis, nulla plane vis comprimens admitti posset
items.english: for if it were perfectly flexible, no compressing force at all could be admitted
